nodes.description: uint256 public seed; randomness seed set to block.timestamp in constructor and consumed by random/pluck/getAge
bool public saleIsActive; gate controlling whether claim() can mint
uint public next_token; sequential token id counter read and incremented in claim()
mapping(uint=>uint) public xp; experience accounting per token id
mapping(uint=>uint) public level; level accounting per token id
mapping(address=>uint) public wards; authorization whitelist used by the auth modifier
uint256 private age = 31; base age used by getAge()
msg.sender; attacker controlled caller used for minting, auth checks, ownership checks and ward setup
block.timestamp; miner influenced value used for seed initialization and age growth
constructor of Role; sets seed = block.timestamp and wards[msg.sender] = 1
claim() public nonReentrant; requires saleIsActive, sets level, _safeMint to _msgSender(), increments next_token
flipSaleState() public onlyOwner; toggles saleIsActive
addXp(uint _tokenId, uint _xp) external auth; adds xp to an existing token
addListXp(uint[] _tokenIds, uint[] _xps) external auth; batch xp addition loop
levelUp(uint _tokenId) external; checks _isApprovedOrOwner, deducts xp and increments level
xp_required(uint curent_level) public pure; computes xp needed for next level
getAge(uint tokenId) public view; computes age from block.timestamp - seed plus plucked base age
rely(address guy) external auth; grants ward by setting wards[guy] = 1
deny(address guy) external auth; revokes ward by setting wards[guy] = 0
pluck(...) internal view; pseudo-random selection over arrays/range seeded by seed
tokenURI(uint tokenId) public view override; builds base64 SVG/JSON metadata
_safeMint performs an external call to IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on the recipient
xp[_tokenId] += _xp; state accounting mutation of the xp mapping
xp[_tokenId] -= _xp_required; state accounting mutation of the xp mapping
xp_to_next_level = curent_level * 1000 plus loop accumulation of i * 1000
require(wards[msg.sender] == 1, "RPK/not-authorized") access control gate in auth modifier
_tokenId parameter of addXp(uint _tokenId, uint _xp)
_xp parameter of addXp(uint _tokenId, uint _xp)
_tokenIds parameter of addListXp(uint[] memory _tokenIds, uint[] memory _xps)
_xps parameter of addListXp(uint[] memory _tokenIds, uint[] memory _xps)
i loop index local variable in addListXp
_tokenId parameter of levelUp(uint _tokenId)
curent_level parameter of xp_required(uint curent_level)
_next_role local variable in claim() caching next_token
growthAge local variable in getAge(uint tokenId)
tokenId parameter of tokenURI(uint tokenId)
keyPrefix parameter of the internal pluck functions
sourceArray parameter of pluck(uint256,string,string[])
guy parameter of rely(address guy)

edges.reason: block.timestamp is read in the constructor and stored into seed (timestamp dependency)
constructor writes state variable seed
constructor uses msg.sender to self-grant wards[msg.sender] = 1
constructor initializes the wards authorization mapping
flipSaleState toggles the saleIsActive state variable
claim requires saleIsActive to be true before minting
claim reads next_token and increments it after minting
claim initializes level[_next_role] = 1
claim calls _safeMint which performs an external callback to the recipient
IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received external callback can re-enter claim before next_token is incremented
claim mints the token to _msgSender() derived from msg.sender
addXp executes xp[_tokenId] += _xp
unchecked statement mutates the xp mapping balance
addListXp loop also executes xp[_tokenId] += _xp
levelUp executes xp[_tokenId] -= _xp_required
xp deduction mutates the xp mapping balance
levelUp reads xp[_tokenId] to compare against the requirement
levelUp writes level[_tokenId] = _level + 1
levelUp calls xp_required to compute the threshold
xp_required computes curent_level * 1000 plus looped i * 1000 accumulation
getAge derives growth from block.timestamp - seed (timestamp dependency)
getAge reads the seed state variable for time growth
getAge obtains the base age through pluck
pluck feeds seed into random() for pseudo-random selection
tokenURI aggregates values produced by pluck through the metadata getters
auth modifier indexes wards with msg.sender
auth modifier reads the wards mapping to validate the caller
addXp is gated by the auth modifier requirement
addListXp is gated by the auth modifier requirement
rely is gated by the auth modifier requirement
deny is gated by the auth modifier requirement
rely writes wards[guy] = 1 granting authorization
deny writes wards[guy] = 0 revoking authorization
levelUp validates msg.sender through _isApprovedOrOwner before leveling

normalization_plan.reason: _tokenId is only the argument used by addXp to index and mutate the xp mapping
_xp is only the addend consumed by the xp[_tokenId] += _xp statement
_tokenIds is only the batch index input iterated by the addXp loop
_xps is only the batch value input paired with _tokenIds in the loop
i is the loop counter that exists solely inside addListXp
_tokenId is only the selector input used by levelUp to read and update xp/level
curent_level is only the multiplicand consumed by the xp_required arithmetic
_next_role is a temporary copy of next_token used only within claim
growthAge is the block.timestamp-derived temporary used only within getAge
tokenId is only the identifier used by tokenURI to gather pluck-derived traits
keyPrefix is only a string salt passed into the internal pluck hashing
sourceArray is only the candidate list indexed by the plucked random value
guy is only the address written into the wards mapping by rely
